params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY lastModifiedDateTime DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.id = D.id

WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
  T.etag__                 = D.etag__,
  T.number                 = D.number,
  T.displayName            = D.displayName,
  T.type                   = D.type,
  T.addressLine1           = D.addressLine1,
  T.addressLine2           = D.addressLine2,
  T.city                   = D.city,
  T.state                  = D.state,
  T.country                = D.country,
  T.postalCode             = D.postalCode,
  T.phoneNumber            = D.phoneNumber,
  T.email                  = D.email,
  T.website                = D.website,
  T.salespersonCode        = D.salespersonCode,
  T.balanceDue             = D.balanceDue,
  T.creditLimit            = D.creditLimit,
  T.taxLiable              = D.taxLiable,
  T.taxAreaId              = D.taxAreaId,
  T.taxAreaDisplayName     = D.taxAreaDisplayName,
  T.taxRegistrationNumber  = D.taxRegistrationNumber,
  T.currencyId             = D.currencyId,
  T.currencyCode           = D.currencyCode,
  T.paymentTermsId         = D.paymentTermsId,
  T.shipmentMethodId       = D.shipmentMethodId,
  T.paymentMethodId        = D.paymentMethodId,
  T.blocked                = D.blocked,
  T.lastModifiedDateTime   = D.lastModifiedDateTime

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
  etag__,
  id,
  number,
  displayName,
  type,
  addressLine1,
  addressLine2,
  city,
  state,
  country,
  postalCode,
  phoneNumber,
  email,
  website,
  salespersonCode,
  balanceDue,
  creditLimit,
  taxLiable,
  taxAreaId,
  taxAreaDisplayName,
  taxRegistrationNumber,
  currencyId,
  currencyCode,
  paymentTermsId,
  shipmentMethodId,
  paymentMethodId,
  blocked,
  lastModifiedDateTime
)
VALUES (
  D.etag__,
  D.id,
  D.number,
  D.displayName,
  D.type,
  D.addressLine1,
  D.addressLine2,
  D.city,
  D.state,
  D.country,
  D.postalCode,
  D.phoneNumber,
  D.email,
  D.website,
  D.salespersonCode,
  D.balanceDue,
  D.creditLimit,
  D.taxLiable,
  D.taxAreaId,
  D.taxAreaDisplayName,
  D.taxRegistrationNumber,
  D.currencyId,
  D.currencyCode,
  D.paymentTermsId,
  D.shipmentMethodId,
  D.paymentMethodId,
  D.blocked,
  D.lastModifiedDateTime
)
"
